title: Jnana Vijnana Yoga
translation: The Yoga of Knowledge and Wisdom
summary: Krishna describes His material and spiritual energies, and how one can know Him through devotion and understanding the underlying reality of existence.

verses.sanskrit:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च |
अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा || ४ ||
verses.translation: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intelligence and false ego—all together these eight constitute My separated material energies.
verses.transliteration:
bhūmir āpo ’nalo vāyuḥ khaṁ mano buddhir eva ca
ahaṅkāra itīyaṁ me bhinnā prakṛtir aṣṭadhā
verses.meaning: Bhumih - earth; Apah - water; Analah - fire; Vayuh - air...

verses.sanskrit:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते |
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः || १९ ||
verses.translation: After many births and deaths, he who is actually in knowledge surrenders unto Me, knowing Me to be the cause of all causes and all that is. Such a great soul is very rare.
verses.transliteration:
bahūnāṁ janmanām ante jñānavān māṁ prapadyate
vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ
verses.meaning: Bahunam - many; Janmanam - of births; Ante - after...
